sentences.en: Taking all things into consideration, his conduct can be excused.
sentences.zh: 考虑到所有情况，他的行为可以得到原谅。

sentences.en: She's by no means lacking in consideration. She's just shy.
sentences.zh: 她并不缺乏体谅之心，只是有些害羞。

sentences.en: You should take into consideration the advice of your mother.
sentences.zh: 你应该考虑一下你妈妈的建议。

senses.zh: 考虑，思考；体贴，考虑周到；重要性，重要因素；报酬，酬劳；考虑因素，要考虑的事项
